fsm_states_target.name: Idle
fsm_states_target.description: No command in progress; CE_n high (deselected) or CE_n low and waiting for CLE/ALE/WE_n strobe. Section 7.1.2.

fsm_states_target.name: Idle_Read
fsm_states_target.description: Target has output data buffer for Read ID / Read Parameter Page / Read Unique ID and is waiting for read strobes. Section 7.1.3.

fsm_states_target.name: Reset_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Reset (FFh) / Synchronous Reset (FCh) / Reset LUN (FAh); target drives R/B_n LOW for tRST (or tSYNCRST / tRST_LUN); returns to Idle when complete. Section 7.1.4.

fsm_states_target.name: Read_ID_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Read ID (90h); target accepts 1-byte address then outputs ≥ 4 ID bytes. Section 7.1.5.

fsm_states_target.name: Read_Parameter_Page_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Read Parameter Page (ECh + 00h); target outputs ≥ 256 bytes (with redundancy). Section 7.1.6.

fsm_states_target.name: Read_Unique_ID_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Read Unique ID (EDh + 00h); target outputs 512 bytes (16 × (UID + complement)). Section 7.1.7.

fsm_states_target.name: Page_Program_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Page Program (80h + addr + data + 10h); target drives R/B_n LOW for tPROG. Section 7.1.8.

fsm_states_target.name: Block_Erase_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Block Erase (60h + addr + D0h); target drives R/B_n LOW for tBERS. Section 7.1.9.

fsm_states_target.name: Read_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Read (00h + addr + 30h); target performs tR then makes page available. Section 7.1.10.

fsm_states_target.name: Set_Features_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Set Features (EFh + feature_addr + 4 P-bytes); target drives R/B_n LOW for tFEAT. Section 7.1.11.

fsm_states_target.name: Get_Features_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Get Features (EEh + feature_addr); target waits tFEAT then outputs 4 P-bytes. Section 7.1.12.

fsm_states_target.name: Read_Status_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Read Status (70h); target outputs the composite status byte. Section 7.1.13.

fsm_states_target.name: Read_Status_Enhanced_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Read Status Enhanced (78h + 3 row addr); target outputs the per-LUN/plane status byte. Section 7.1.14.

fsm_states_target.name: Volume_Select_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After Volume Select (E1h + Volume Address); target updates active volume. Section 7.1.15.

fsm_states_target.name: ODT_Configure_Command_States
fsm_states_target.description: After ODT Configure (E2h); target updates matrix termination configuration. Section 7.1.16.

fsm_states_lun.name: Idle
fsm_states_lun.description: No command in progress on this LUN; R/B_n contribution = HIGH. Section 7.2.2.

fsm_states_lun.name: Idle_Read
fsm_states_lun.description: LUN has data in page register available for read. Section 7.2.3.

fsm_states_lun.name: Status_State
fsm_states_lun.description: LUN selected for Read Status; outputs status byte on DQ. Section 7.2.4.

fsm_states_lun.name: Reset_State
fsm_states_lun.description: Per-LUN reset (FAh Reset LUN); R/B_n LOW. Section 7.2.5.

fsm_states_lun.name: Block_Erase_State
fsm_states_lun.description: LUN performing erase; R/B_n LOW. Section 7.2.6.

fsm_states_lun.name: Read_State
fsm_states_lun.description: LUN performing array-to-page-register read for tR; R/B_n LOW. Section 7.2.7.

fsm_states_lun.name: Page_Program_State / Page_Cache_Program_State
fsm_states_lun.description: LUN programming page register to array; R/B_n LOW (raw NAND) or pipelined (Page Cache). Section 7.2.8.

fsm_transitions_major.description: Universal reset; all volatile state cleared.

fsm_transitions_major.target: Idle (keeps NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 + timing mode)
fsm_transitions_major.description: Used after parity error to recover without losing data interface.
Resets only the addressed LUN; other LUNs continue.
Array → page register, then host reads page.
Outputs composite status byte until next command.
Outputs per-LUN/plane status; turns off other LUN output buffers.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: Multi-plane Read / Program / Erase 11h or D1h continuation
fsm_transitions_major.description: Queue plane operations; final 30h / 10h / D0h commits all planes concurrently.
Directs subsequent commands to the addressed volume.
Periodic ZQ recalibration for V/T drift.

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_POWER_UP
fsm_states_host.description: Apply Vcc, VccQ, then de-assert WP_n; staggered if multiple targets share rail (Section 2.14).

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_DISCOVERY
fsm_states_host.description: Issue Reset (FFh), wait for R/B_n HIGH; Read ID (90h) with addr 20h to detect 'ONFI' signature; Read Parameter Page (ECh).

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_INIT
fsm_states_host.description: Validate Parameter Page CRC; determine geometry, ECC requirements, supported timing modes; Set Features (timing mode, drive strength, ODT).

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_CE_REDUCTION
fsm_states_host.description: If CE_n reduction supported, perform Volume Appointment via ENi/ENo enumeration; Volume Select (E1h) thereafter.

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_TRAINING
fsm_states_host.description: For NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3: ZQ Calibration Long (F9h); for NV-DDR3: DCC training, Read DQ Training, Write TX/RX DQ Training.

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_TRANSFER
fsm_states_host.description: Page Program / Read / Block Erase / Multi-plane operations; Read Status polling between operations.

fsm_states_host.name: HOST_IDLE
fsm_states_host.description: Bus quiescent; CE_n may be HIGH for low-power standby.

fsm_hints.trigger: Host drives all command/address strobes; device never initiates. R/B_n is the only device-driven async signal.
fsm_hints.rule: Status bit 6 (RDY) reflects per-LUN ready state; R/B_n combines all LUNs on the target as logical-AND (open-drain wired-OR of busy).
fsm_hints.abort: Reset (FFh) is the universal abort; Synchronous Reset (FCh) preserves data interface; Reset LUN (FAh) is per-LUN.

anti_deadlock_rule: Host shall not issue a new command to a LUN while its RDY bit is 0, except Read Status (70h), Read Status Enhanced (78h), Reset (FFh), Synchronous Reset (FCh), Reset LUN (FAh).
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on the target requires power-on reset (Reset FFh) before any commands; the target defaults to SDR data interface, timing mode 0, with all volatile state cleared. WP_n is sampled during reset to disable Program / Erase.

default_ready_state_recommendation.DQS_idle: Driven HIGH by host during NV-DDR2/3 Idle if ODT is enabled (otherwise don't-care).
default_ready_state_recommendation.R_B_n_idle: HIGH via external pull-up; LOW only when at least one LUN is busy.
default_ready_state_recommendation.WP_n_idle: LOW = write-protect engaged; HIGH = Program/Erase enabled.

configurations.name: SDR mode
configurations.description: Default after Reset (FFh). Asynchronous; WE_n latches commands/addresses/writes.

configurations.name: NV-DDR mode
configurations.description: Selected via Set Features (01h timing mode); CLK on WE_n pin; DQS bidirectional source-synchronous strobe.

configurations.name: NV-DDR2 mode
configurations.description: Selected via Set Features (01h timing mode + 02h NV-DDR2/3 Configuration); WE_n still latches cmd/addr; DQS differential.

configurations.name: NV-DDR3 mode
configurations.description: Selected via Set Features (01h timing mode + 02h NV-DDR2/3 Configuration); differential DQS and RE_t/RE_c; full DCC + DQ training required.

timing_dependency_rule: All commands are issued via CLE+WE_n (cmd) and ALE+WE_n (addr) cycles. Read data: SDR — falling edge of RE_n drives next byte; NV-DDR — DQS edges on both rising and falling. Write data: SDR — rising edge of WE_n latches; NV-DDR — DQS edges. The host shall respect tCCS, tWHR, tWB, tRR, tFEAT timing parameters per Section 4.17 for the active data interface.
